findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.14 Handwashing signs are not posted in the public restrooms. Per Assistant Manager, there are two sets of employee restrooms available for use, which is preferred. However, staff may also use the public restrooms. Handwashing signs are needed in all restrooms used by staff. 
A sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands shall be provided at all handwashing sinks used by food employees and shall be clearly visible to food employees.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-304.11 General accumulation of mold, dirt, and old food debris were observed in fresh produce bins. Cleaning frequency was discussed. Produce department staff were advised as to the conditions and started cleaning during inspection. Additional cleaning is needed in the cold case by the entrance (see #49). Management and staff need time to allow for proper cleaning and sanitization throughout the produce cases in question, so additional time is being given to accomplish this task.
Ensure liners are replaced, and surfaces under liners are cleaned and sanitized. Ensure removable inserts that divide products are cleaned and sanitized at the 3 part sink. These cleaning and sanitization practices need to happen at a frequency that does not allow for accumulation of mold, dirt, and old food debris as was observed today. 
Food shall only contact equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized as specified in Parts 4-6 and 4-7 of this Code; single-service and single-use articles; and linens, such as cloth napkins, as specified under § 3 304.13 that are laundered as specified under Part 4-8 of this Code.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Solution in sani-bucket used to start wiping down the back wall in the produce case was at 0ppm quat. Fresh solution was provided at 200ppm. Ensure use of quat test strips to verify sanitizer is at proper concentration when dispensed for use. 
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Ensure product is maintained at 150-400ppm as required per product label directions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text:
4-602.13 The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled:
1) produce case where commercially processed packages of leafy greens are located by the entrance (mold on back wall);
2) shelving and inserts on shelves in the milk cooler (mold/general buildup); and
3) surfaces around door seals at milk cooler (splash/general debris). 
Nonfood contact surfaces shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to eliminate buildup of grease, food splash and general debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 1) Two tiles were missing from the floor in the first stall of the women’s employee restroom by upstairs break area. Small cracks were present in the subfloor. Seal the subfloor and/or replace the tiles. 
2) Caulking was observed worn at the juncture between the urinal and the wall in the men’s employee restroom upstairs by offices. Re-seal the area.
3) Caulking was observed worn at the juncture between the handwashing sink and the wall in the women’s employee restroom upstairs by offices. Re-seal the area.
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:

2) Floor was soiled with dried food splash and general debris along the doors at the reach-in section of the milk cooler.
Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

findings.comment:

findings.comment:

750-130(d)  All raw meat shall be properly stored, store in the order of their cooking requirements with the lowest temperatures on the top shelf and the highest required temperature product on the bottom.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:

750-1400 Live animals including birds and turtles, shall be excluded from within the food service operational premises.

findings.comment:

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: CORRECTED> Observed a breaded stuffing mixture dated 10/26 and a jalepeno meat stuffing mixture with no date in the small meat room walk in. Label all potentially hazardous foods with the date of preparation and hold no longer than 7 days from that date. Breaded stuffing was discarded and jalepeno mix was dated with Tuesday's date as it was made Tuesday.
findings.citation_text: 750.140 Potentially hazardous foods shall be labeled with the date of preparation and held no longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Potentially hazardous foods properly thawed
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed turkey tenderloins thawing at ambient air temperature in the meat department. Use a proper thawing method which includes thawing in a cooler, thawing under cool, running water, thawing as part of the cooking process. Tenderloins were moved to the walk in cooler.
750-240 Potentially hazardous foods shall be properly thawed by one of the  following method. 1. Under refrigeration 41°F or below, 2. Under  potable running water 70°F or below or below with sufficient water velocity to agitate and float off loose food particles into the over-flow, 3. In microwave as part of the cooking process, 4. As part of the cooking process.

Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings. 750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:

Personal drinks cannot be stored in food prep areas or food storage areas unless in has a straw and lid and then must be stored area from food and food prep tables.
750-530a Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed the sanitizer concentration of the three compartment sink in the meat cutting cooler to be at 0 ppm of Quaternary Ammonia sanitizer. Concentrations of Quaternary ammonia must be maintained between 200 and 400 ppm based on the manufactures recommendations. Sanitizer solution was remade to a proper concentration.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored

750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils

750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed

750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

750-1120(d) Each lavatory shall be  provided with hot and cold water tempered by a means of a mixing valve or combo faucet

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
1) No self closer was observed on the women's restroom. Provide a self-closer for the door. 2) observed no paper towels at the meat department hand sink. provide paper towels at each lavatory.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited

Eliminate cardboard and unsound produce. Place fly strips as needed (away from food pre and storage areas). Effective pest control measures must take place.
750-1160 Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
Observed both front exit doors to contain gaps around and between the doors. Seal doors so that no light is visible between them and the frame when the doors are shut.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the floors through out the walk-in coolers and back storage areas to be soiled with food debris, dust, and cardboard with heavy accumulation under tables, shelves, and where the walls meet the floors. Clean all floors in walk-ins and storage areas. 2) Observed a hole in the floor in aisle 9. Seal the hole. 3) observed the column next to the produce floor double doors to be in disrepair repair the wall to be smooth and easily cleanable. 4) Observed missing coving and unsealed coving throughout the produce back storage areas with exposed foam and foam caulking. Seal all gaps between floor and wall with smooth and easily cleanable surfaces. 5) Observed the floor drains in the meat department to be soiled. Clean drains. 6) Observed missing coving in the meat cooler. Replace missing coving.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean

1) observed the ceiling tile in the walk in dairy cooler to have a gap between it and the frame of the drop ceiling. Repair or replace ceiling tile. 2) Observed rusting ceilings in the produce walk-in, ice cream walk-in, and meat walk-in. Remove all rust. 3) observed the ceilings and walls to be soiled throughout the back storage room.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
750-1210(b) Walls and ceilings in walk-in refrigeration units, food preparation areas, equipment washing areas, and toilet rooms shall be smooth, light-cored, non-absorbant, and easily cleanable. Concrete or pumice block in these locations shall be finished and sealed to provide a cleanable surface.
750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment:
Observed broken light shields in the 1) dairy walk-in cooler. 2) Ham display cooler. repair or replace light shields.
750-1240 All lights in the food prep, food storage or kitchen area of a establishment must be properly shielded (i.e. either have a physical shield or be a shatter resistant bulb) so as to reduce the potential for cross contamination in case of breakage.  Provide properly shielded lights.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment:
Observed coats being stored on shelving units touching produce and single service items. All personal belongings must be stored in a designated area away from food and food service items.
750-1280 Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 1210: The floor under the mop sink in the alchol room is missing some tiles. Floors shall be smooth andin good repair. Replace the missing floor tiles.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 1210: The walls in the walk-in cooler have been cleaned and look great. there remains a section in the back that is bubbling. Walls shall be maintain smooth and easily cleanable. repair the wall.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: 750-130f Several plastic containers of unidentifiable foods were observed in the walk-in cooler behind the meat counter. Place common name label on all items. Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment: 750-130(d)  Observed cartons of eggs stored above mushrooms in the walk-in cooler of the cut-to-serve meat line. Stored on bottom shelf during inspection. All raw meat shall be properly stored, store in the order of their cooking requirements with the lowest temperatures on the top shelf and the highest required temperature product on the bottom.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment: 750-510a Observed gloved hand employee screw lid into grease trap, then handle chemicals to discard and simply change gloves before preparing to take a customers order. Hands should be properly washed inbetween tasks and glove use. Discussed handwashing with employee. Employee removed gloves and began washing hands. Employees shall properly wash their hands any time their hands may have become contaminated and prior to handling food or clean equipment.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment: 750-530a See note in General Comments. Personal drinks are everywhere! Dry storage, cold storage, on counters, on shelves. Keep personal drinks away from food and single-service preparation and storage areas. Have clearly marked, designated stations in convenient locations for employees to easily set drink, take a drink, and then be able to quickly wash hands after drinking. Employees shall consume food only in designated dining areas. An employee dining area shall not be so designated if consuming food there may result in contamination of other food, equipment, utensils, or other items needing protection.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-650a The cutting boards of the produce areas are marred to the point they can no longer be easily cleaned. Cutting boards are scratched and black. Replace or sand the cutting boards. Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 Cut-to-order meats has a sticky drawer holding personals, medications, and skewers. Repair drawer so it can be easily used and monitored and does not become a catch-all. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750-800(b) The wall-mounted knife racks were observed to be black with soil in the meat cutting room and the produce room. Asked to remove and clean during inspection. Hinged areas of the cutting boards attached to the cut-to-order raw meat kitchen are soiled. Within meat rooms: plastics holding skewers and seasonings were bloody and coated with accumulation of soil. To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e Within the meat-cutting room: wall-mounted racks and equipment are coated with pink accumulation of soaps and blood. Discussed the need to clean with employee. Roll carts within the multiple meat rooms are soiled. Some of the plexiglass labels in the produce display are soiled. Chocolate milk splash on front shelves of dairy case. Frozen end caps displays are soiled - base shelf. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-860 Throughout facility, watch wall mounted knife racks and containers holding lids and utensils. Multiple areas are storing clean knives and equipment within soiled containers. Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750-1060 There is a leak from the neck of the drain in the meat cutting room handsink. Watch presence of hot water at wash sink in produce kitchen. Hot water is not  always available at this sink. Produce is cut sporadically throughout the day and manager stated he has hot water in the mornings to fill his wash basin. There are many areas around sinks where water is present. Inspect for leaks and low grouted areas and repair as needed.  All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment:
750-1160 Fruit flies in the produce area and drain flies in the cut-to-order meat display. See notes in General Comments. Facility needs to address pest control throughout facility.
Keep facility in sound repair and clean. Eliminate cardboard and unsound produce. Place fly strips as needed (away from food preparation and storage areas). Spray may be used in areas where food preparation is not occurring and during the overnight slow periods. Effective measures to minimize the presence of rodents and insects shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200 See notes in General Comments. There are some servious concrete cracks around sinks, floor drains and especially in the dairy walk-in cooler. Look around meat rooms and replace missing coving as needed. Small sections of cut-to-order walk-in cooler are missing. Floors in walk-in coolers and freezers are filthy. Especially areas where there is ice accumulating. The unused portion of the basement has mouse droppings and sticky traps along the walls. Remove droppings and inspect for points of entry. All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1210 See notes in General Comments. Every area has concerns. Walls are bubbling in the walk-in dairy cooler. Walls around handsink and three part sink in meat cutters room are frothy pink with accumulated blood and soap splash. All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.comment: 750-1280 Coats, keys, personals are observed throughout drawers and shelves of facility. There are lockers in the break room - use them. Store coats used for long-term walk-in freezer projects on designated hooks and not on the ends of racks holding foods. Adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food preparation and food storage area to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 There are degreasers and window cleaners observed throughout facility. In the meat cutting room there were observed various alcohols and toxics stored throughout the shelving. Moved during inspection to the floor.  All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: 750-1160 There are flies throughout the facility. Lack of proper cleaning, proper maintenance and general pest control practices are contributing to the problem. Eliminate water and food sources. The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-650a Cutting board surfaces within the meat room and the produce area are so marred and worn that they are allowing the food contact surface to hold blood, mold, and general soil. Make sure that cutting boards are replaced on a routine basis that does not allow for this food contact surface to accumulate mold and soil. Also, within the meat room several tubs storing raw meat were observed to have broken sides. Food contact surfaces should be intact and able to be properly cleanable. Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 Handsink in the meat room and the three part sink of the produce area are in need of proper caulking to the wall. Caulk should not be moldy. Maintain sinks clean and maintained. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: 750-810b Observed a wet wiping cloth stored on the cutting board within the produce area. During the inspection, the cloth was placed into sanitizer. Discussed the need to properly maintain a sani-bucket within every area of the store. Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750-800e The display freezers are forming water droplets on the doors due to the humidity of the day and the constant temperature fluctuations as restocking is occurring. This is resulting in an accumulation of red slime mold on the lip of the outside of the display doors. Clean the display freezers - entire aisle. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 In the basement, single-service aluminum roaster pans are being stored uncovered with the food contact surface exposed. Keep serving equipment covered while in the basement. Also, produce area has single service containers on the floor. Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.750-880 Single-service articles shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in closed cartons or containers which protect them from contamination and shall not be placed under exposed sewer lines or  water lines, except for automatic fire protection sprinkler heads may be required by law.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: 750-1130(e) A roll cart of soiled mop waste water was observed within the produce area. During the inspection, discussed the need to promptly dispose of waste water with produce operator and assistant store manager. Water was discarded immediately. Liquid waste from compacting or cleaning operations shall be disposed of as sewage and shall be immediately emtied.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
750-1200 The wood baseboard around the produce area and the sealed walk-in cooler to the left of this area is starting to soiled and be scratched. Properly seal the coving so the surface is maintained smooth, non-absorbent, and easily cleanable. The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.
750-1220 Floors throughout are clean. Watch floors beneath shelves of the walk in freezers and coolers. Make sure carts on wheels are being regularly moved and swept beneath. Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750-1220 To the left of the produce area is a walk-in cooler with a sealed door (foam caulking around door). This door is not tightly sealed and there is a slight accumulation of black mold around the base of the door. Make sure seal is tight. Clean and sanitize the wall so black mold is removed. Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: 750-1350c Within the construction storage section of the basement there was observed a  number of old ceiling tiles with mouse droppings atop. The assistant store manager was notified and discussed pest control. The ceiling tiles are old. Located in the middle of the large room. The droppings are old. During the inspection, the on-site maintenance manager was told to have the ceiling tiles removed. The basement is large enough to accommodate the storage of construction materials - make sure soiled items are immediately removed. Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Observed a piece of cardboard and duct tape being used on a door to cover a window in the meat cutting room.  Remove the cardboard and duct tape, including any tape residue, so that the door in this area is smooth and easily cleanable.

750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the inside of the ice machine located in the produce area of the store to be soiled.  The plastic piece located on the inside at the top of the ice machine, the inside sides of the ice machine, as well as the inside of the lid where rust is present.  Clean and sanitize the inside of the ice machine to prevent contamination of the ice.  

 750-800e: Food contact surfaces shall be clean to prevent the contamination of food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following non-food contact surfaces to be soiled: 1. white wire shelves in the dairy cooler, where the milk is stored for sale  2. paper towel dispenser and wall around the 3 compartment sink in the meat cutting room  3. compressor fan covers located in the walk-in dairy cooler have dust accumulation   Clean the above mentioned items.

750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Hand washing sinks installed, located, accessible
findings.comment:
Observed the hand sink located in the meat cutting area to be blocked and not easily accessible for handwashing.  Employee states that one sink of the 3 part sink is used for handwashing.  The 3 compartment sink shall not be used for handwashing and the handwashing sink shall be clear of items, in the sink and around the area, at all times so that handwashing can be convenient and done so properly.  The sink was cleared during inspection.  *Violation Corrected*

750-1120(b) Lavatories shall be accessible to employees at all times.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas of floor in the facility to be soiled:  1. basement floor area around the large electric box  2. floor drain by the 3 compartment sink and hand sink in the meat cutting room  3. floor behind and under the hand sink in the meat display/service area  Clean the above mentioned areas of the floor.

Observed the floor to be in disrepair in the dairy walk-in cooler, where the concrete floor has large chips or pieces missing from it.  Repair the floor in the dairy walk-in cooler, so that it is non-absorbant, smooth, and easily cleanable.

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.
